name: Task

  be a direct part of a User Story, and they should be very trivial and well-justified
  if they are not.
title: ''

---

# Assignee
- For purposes of Sprint Review, this work should be doable by a single person, and they should be assigned. This can happen after the task is created.

# Description
- Only the most trivial tasks should be explainable solely by their title.

# Completion
- It should be possible to complete the task with a single Pull Request. Link this issue in the Pull Request - you don't need to explicitly reference it here.
